title: Request a delegation worktree sweep when a named source root ends by release, reclamation, capacity eviction or binding retain
outcome: An ended delegation's worktree held only by a named source root is reclaimed as soon as that root ends by any path, not at the next unrelated event or boot.
acceptance: Every path that removes a named source root (release in engram_named_root_release.rs, reclamation, capacity eviction, binding retain) requests a delegation worktree sweep pass after the removal is published.
A behavioural test shows that ending the last named root holding an ended clean delegation's worktree, by one of those paths, leads to the worktree's removal without another event.
